xorriso.indev.description: Input drive path (e.g., /dev/sr0) or empty string to start a new image. If empty, a new blank ISO image is created.

xorriso.outdev.description: Output drive path or file path where the ISO image will be written (e.g., /dev/sr1 or /path/to/output.iso).

xorriso.volid.description: The Volume ID (label) of the resulting ISO 9660 image.

xorriso.joliet.description: Whether to enable Joliet file name extensions for better Windows compatibility.

xorriso.out_charset.description: The character set used for encoding filenames in the ISO image (e.g., UTF-8, ISO-8859-1).

xorriso.volume_date.description: The timestamp for the volume creation/modification. 'default' uses current time.

xorriso.speed.description: Burn speed for optical media (e.g., max, 4x, 16x).

xorriso.padding.description: Padding to append to the image stream (e.g., 0, 300k for CDs).

xorriso.fs_mb.description: Size of the FIFO buffer in MiB for smoothing data streams.

xorriso.source_files.description: List of source file or directory paths to add to the ISO image from the local filesystem. Items are strings representing file paths.

xorriso.directories.description: List of ISO 9660 pathnames of directories to create within the image if they do not exist. Items are strings.

xorriso.permissions.description: List of permission changes to apply within the ISO image. Each item is an object with 'mode' (octal string like '0755') and 'path' (ISO path).
